subject: english
stem: Claim: Pair discussion can help learners notice errors. Which example best serves as evidence?
options: The teacher chose a new chair.
Two students compared answers and found a sign error neither had seen alone.
Two students sat at different tables silently and never compared any answer.
An answer sheet used large print.

optionRationales.reason: The teacher chose a new chair.：無關。
Two students compared answers and found a sign error neither had seen alone.：pair discussion 導向發現 error。
An answer sheet used large print.：無 pair/error detection。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「例子必須具備主張中的關鍵條件，且結果方向能作為該主張的具體個案」可推出 Two students compared answers and found a sign error neither had seen alone.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Two students compared answers and found a sign error neither had seen alone. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
